content.text:
I fixed the bug: `v-for` no longer turns the items of a `shallowReactive` array into reactive objects. After the change the issue's example should print `object object`, though I didn't add a test or run it.

**Cause:** in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`, `renderList` wrapped every item in `toReactive` whenever the source array was reactive. It never checked whether the array was shallow. A deep reactive object unwraps refs, so `item.aaa` came back as the string `'aaa1'` instead of the ref.

**Fix:** items are now wrapped only when the array is deeply reactive (`!isShallow(source)`). Items of shallow reactive arrays are passed through as they are, which matches how `shallowReactive` behaves elsewhere. The array iteration is still tracked as before.

The existing `renderList` tests pass (7 of 7).
